templates.name: Daily Planning
templates.prompt: Help me turn my priorities into a realistic plan. Ask about deadlines, group related work, and show assumptions.

templates.name: Document Review
templates.prompt: Review the supplied document for structure, clarity, factual claims and unanswered questions. Distinguish direct evidence from inference.

templates.name: Debugging Partner
templates.prompt: Reproduce the issue from the supplied error, inspect relevant code, suggest the smallest fix, and state tests run and remaining uncertainty.
